finished_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D4 independent project exemplar, composition and decisions matter, not necessarily more details than D3. Scene: Series location A, afternoon: ONE low ochre stone garden wall from lower left to middle right, ONE small rounded olive-and-mustard shrub behind its right end, pale beige narrow dirt lane in front. Pale gray-green ground, white sky. Warm afternoon light from upper right creates LONG muted lavender flat cast shadow extending lower left along lane. Fixed view slightly above wall, same subject layout as a noon companion. No flowers, houses or extra objects. Moderate brushstroke landscape, broad masses. Palette: 25 very pale gray-beige; 95 ochre brown; 31 mustard yellow; 41 dark olive; 75 pale lavender; 172 extremely pale gray-green. Keep relative hue character, these are planning labels not calibrated exact colors.

S002 sunlit natural brushstroke marker style, broad masses, irregular organic plant strokes and white gaps, no circular leaf blobs or dot borders. Title exact Chinese: S002-031 同一角落·午后 · 构思与结构. Top tool codes: 25,95,31,41,75,172. Each panel has given numbered Chinese title and ONLY ONE SHORT readable Chinese instruction hint, not the entire paragraph below; drawings occupy most panel area. White page, thin gray dividers, generous margins. The full instructions below constrain what to illustrate, not all to print. Panel instructions: 1 两种小稿 — Show TWO small pencil thumbnails with different focal placement or framing for this same subject, mark A and B, genuinely different possible layouts, no final colors. 2 三组大形 — Chosen-example thumbnail only; show pale flat masses for main subject, support and reserved white; add small light-source arrow and focal dot. 3 结构与留白 — Large pencil STRUCTURE STUDY: 沿用上幅母稿，只改光色与影长；AI预览有细小取景差异，实际练习不能随之移动主体。 Show critical connections and white gaps, no dense foliage. 4 配色与顺序 — Separated numeric color swatches using ONLY 25,95,31,41,75,172 and a SIMPLE chosen-example block-in, NOT final rendering. No opaque white over dark, no smooth digital gradients, no thick black outline. No extra subjects.
